title: Italian B2B Lead List Scoring, Ranking & JSON Decisions
description: Prioritize an existing Italian B2B lead list into up to 250 explained JSON decisions.
summary: Prioritize an existing Italian B2B lead list into up to 250 explained JSON decisions.
offersHint: Prioritize an existing Italian B2B lead list into up to 250 explained JSON decisions. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.machinesignal.it/mcp

toolsPreview.name: map_business_need
toolsPreview.description: Map any structured B2B business need from Italy or a foreign market for aggregate product research. Italy remains the only commercial sales scope; foreign signals are research-only. The tool accepts only closed semantic fields and never creates a product or order.

toolsPreview.name: get_product_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Find an API product to score, classify, rank and prioritize an existing Italian B2B company or lead list into up to 250 explained JSON decisions. Returns the canonical catalog and permanent safety boundaries; read-only and no buyer data.

toolsPreview.name: check_buyer_fit
toolsPreview.description: Check whether an Italian B2B buyer with an existing company, domain, CRM or lead list can use MS-DEC-250 to score, rank and prioritize up to 250 records. Coarse non-personal facts only; it creates no order.

toolsPreview.name: get_synthetic_example
toolsPreview.description: Preview the JSON produced when MachineSignal scores, classifies, ranks and prioritizes an Italian B2B lead list. Uses approved synthetic data only and creates no order.

toolsPreview.name: get_purchase_requirements
toolsPreview.description: Explain the machine-origin purchase prerequisites without accepting an order, returning checkout data or calling a provider.

toolsPreview.name: prepare_order_intent
toolsPreview.description: Return the canonical endpoint, OpenAPI, 17 required fields and a locally fillable MS-DEC-250 template. It accepts no buyer data and never creates an order.
